cases.title: Double-click on the DP1 downpipe circle opens the CE Edit source window
cases.expected: A double-click on the outer circle of a freshly placed downpipe (tag DP1) opens CE's 'Edit source' window with DP1 in its Tag box, and not AutoCAD's Enhanced Attribute Editor. Cancel closes it.
cases.why_not_unit: Unit tests passed while the real AutoCAD double-click still reached EATTEDIT with nothing picked (BUG-859 round 1); only a real mouse double-click on a real block shows which window opens.
not_automated: The name of the Tag box in the Edit source window is not proven (the window has never opened); the check 'control Tag value DP1' uses the name 'Tag' and may need that one word corrected once the fix is installed.

Batch 3 fixes of 25 Oct 2026: run unchanged first on Civil 3.0.75 it FAILED for the real reason (the double-click opened AutoCAD's Enhanced Attribute Editor, run b3r09a), so the Tag box name is still unknown. Cancel is now pressed with ui-press (Edit source, Cancel) and its closing is asserted; close-windows stays behind it only to put AutoCAD right if the wrong window opened. The true red after this edit is the variant R09_OFF_BROKEN (the switch doubleClick.sourceEditWindow set false: AutoCAD's editor must open).

Batch 4 (26 Oct 2026, Civil 3.0.77): evidence for BUG-859 from CE own log at every double-click of runs on 3.0.75 (b3r09a, b3w1, b3z4): "double-click hit-test: 1 block(s) under the pointer; source tag = DP1", "pick set emptied so EATTEDIT stops at its prompt", "CANCELCMD posted=true for EATTEDIT", "CDEDIT scheduled at Idle", then "starting CDEDIT in command context" only 21 to 37 s later, after the robot had closed AutoCAD Enhanced Attribute Editor. So CE catches the double-click but AutoCAD editor still opens first. The check log civilx has CDEDIT scheduled at Idle (civilx = the structured CE log ce_cvl_structured_<date>.log, a runner key added 26 Oct 2026 because the first try with log civil could not pass on any build: those lines are written only to the structured log, not to CE_CVL_SUITE.log; runs b4c1 b4c2) passes when the switch is ON and must FAIL in R09_OFF_BROKEN, where CE logs EATTEDIT left to AutoCAD: the double-click switch reads OFF (that is its true red). R09 itself stays a real fault (EXPECT-FAIL BUG-859) because AutoCAD editor opens first.
The red centre, the angled DP text and the green label (BUG-860) are not clicked here; only the outer circle named in the bug.

Run B5 evidence (26 Oct 2026, Civil 3.0.78+d8840a09, run RUN-20261026-1312-C3.0.78-b5a1, the first run in which the log check read the right log): in CE structured log at 13:18:20 "TryRedirectToCdEdit: target registered; CDEDIT scheduled at Idle" was present (check 2 PASSED); the robot window list after the double-click read only "Enhanced Attribute Editor" (checks 3 to 6 FAILED, real fault BUG-859 on 3.0.78); with doubleClick.sourceEditWindow OFF the variant FAILED check 2 (96 new log lines, no scheduled-CDEDIT line). Scope (cx_cr02): outer-circle opening and Cancel only; the red centre, the angled DP text and OK saving a changed tag are not proved; whole BUG-859 not proved.
